issues.title: Rule: no CI runs on a host whose runner layer is undeclared or whose guard is not observed live, and the runner layer is documented
non_scope: Choosing the runner of a job (I4242, #2596)
Provisioning the runner units and rendering their drop-in (I4352)
Writing and publishing the observation (I4343)
issues.objective: A blocking project rule, no-ci-routes-to-an-undeclared-runner-host, held at two points. In the repository, a typed capability, mesh.runner_routing (`majordomus mesh runner-routing`), run as a gate in structure, fails when a self-hosted label reachable from a workflow or from a repository variable's default names no policy node that declares its runner units, their homes, their caps and the guard, observation and watchdog timers. On the host, the build host policy installs a runner job-started hook (apps/majordomus-cli/assets/mesh-cache-provider/runner-job-started, set as ACTIONS_RUNNER_HOOK_JOB_STARTED in the runner units' drop-in) that fails the job at its start, naming the failing item, while the host's latest observation (/var/lib/majordomus/build-host.json, written every five minutes by I4343) is missing, failing or older than 15 minutes; so a host whose guard has stopped takes no CI, and the refusal does not wait for anyone to ask. docs/CI.md gains a section 'Self-hosted runners' with the runbook of the 2026-10-28 recovery.
issues.why: Incident 1 of 2026-10-28: lundra's runners lundra-1..3 went offline when its disk filled during run 40680986818; the runner layer had been provisioned by hand on 2026-10-26 (I4242's non_scope, on feature/lundra-is-the-first-wave) and is declared nowhere, and #2596 routes validate's first wave to lundra through MJ_RUNNER, widening the exposure. Its root cause was that no check fails while the guard is missing; a validator that reads only the policy, or a doctor nobody runs, would repeat it: if disk-guard.timer stopped again, CI would keep routing to lundra until the disk filled. The review's order for lundra serving CI 24/7 is I4343, I4344, I4346, I4345 and then this rule. The runner units' drop-in is rendered by I4352 (fix/lundra-provisions-its-runners, not landed), which this issue takes into depends_on once it is on master. The repository half is a capability, not a script, under ADR 0069; the hook is a host payload with a platform-adaptor exemption, as disk-guard is.
issues.current_state: Measured at 81ef931a3e1: apps/majordomus-cli/assets/mesh-cache-provider/policy.json declares no runner unit, home or cap; no rule names a self-hosted label; nothing on lundra refuses a job while its guard is down; docs/CI.md has no section on self-hosted runners.
issues.desired_state: Routing a workflow to a self-hosted label fails validate unless the label's host declares its runner layer; a job that reaches a host whose latest observation is missing, failing or stale fails at its start, naming the item, instead of filling the disk; the docs name every unit, its HOME, its cap and the timers that guard it. Enforced by the capability's gate in structure, the job-started hook on the host, case 4359 and the rule.
acceptance_criteria: Unit test of mesh::runner_routing and case 4359: the gate fails on a workflow routing to lundra while the policy declares no runner units for it, and passes once they are declared
Case 4359 with fixture observation files: missing, verdict fail, and 16 minutes old each make runner-job-started exit non-zero naming the item; a passing observation 4 minutes old exits 0
Unit test: the provision plan installs runner-job-started and sets ACTIONS_RUNNER_HOOK_JOB_STARTED in each declared runner unit's drop-in
On lundra: with build-host-observe.timer stopped for 16 minutes a job routed there fails at its start naming the stale observation, and passes again once the timer runs (evidence names both runs)
Case 4359: docs/CI.md names each declared runner unit, its HOME, its cap and the guard, observation and watchdog timer names

`majordomus shell check` passes with runner-job-started carrying an F (platform adaptor) exemption in .ai/repo/automation/inventory.jsonl giving why (the runner runs a hook as a script) and removal (the runner can call the executable directly)

issues.title: The economics runner starts a freshly written harness once it is free, and a harness that cannot start has no version
non_scope: The session timeout: a timed-out session is already recorded, ended `timeout`
Other modules' starters, already on retrying_busy (I2827)
issues.objective: apps/majordomus-cli/src/economics/runner.rs starts the harness and the treatment's majordomus through crate::process::retrying_busy (spawn_group, harness_version, run_quiet), and harness_version returns the start error instead of the version `unknown`, so a transient ETXTBSY neither drops a run nor reads as the harness changing under it.
issues.why: Train 10a's validate run 40798671348 (job 123214165485, lane rust (2)) failed economics::runner::tests::a_session_that_failed_or_timed_out_is_not_a_completed_run at runner.rs:1492 (NotFound in the test's record()). Its first section writes a stand-in harness and runs it at once; a child another libtest thread forked meanwhile held the file open for writing, Linux refused the exec (ETXTBSY), harness_version turned that into `unknown`, the end-of-run version read 1.2.3, and run_job refused to record the run. The section discarded run()'s failed list, so the reason was lost. process.rs documents the same window (I2827, CI run 39049547899); runner.rs was the one starter left without the retry.
issues.current_state: Measured at 5370ee63d19: spawn_group calls cmd.spawn() and run_quiet cmd.output() without retrying_busy; harness_version maps any start failure to `unknown`; the first section of the failing test ignores run()'s failed list.
issues.desired_state: Every start in the runner waits out a program still open for writing; a harness that cannot start fails the run with the start error; a test that loses a record says why. Enforced on Linux by unit tests that hold the harness open for writing while it is started, which fail without the retry.
acceptance_criteria: economics::runner::tests::every_start_waits_for_a_program_still_open_for_writing: spawn_group, harness_version and run_quiet each start a harness held open for writing for 300 ms
economics::runner::tests::a_run_whose_harness_was_just_written_is_recorded: a run whose harness is held for 500 ms is recorded with version 1.2.3
